      "published_at": "2024-10-30T00:10:00+00:00",
      "link": null,
      "description": "Marjolein Robertson is a Scottish stand-up comedian, actress and wonderful human from way up north in Shetland. How did coming from such a remote island shape her childhood? What games did she play with her brother that are unique only to them? How is she such a fountain of knowledge about Shetland? It is halloween so it is our theme of the week and all the way from America we speak to halloween historian Lisa Morton. Learn where the traditions of halloween came from and why pumpkins are the vegetable of choice for your spooky creations. Read more about Lisa and buy her book - lisamorton.com Harry’s new book How To Be Silly Every Day Of The Year is out, order here !       "description": "You’ve probably seen George Lewis’s excellent takes on what life is like as a parent in today’s world or even putting himself into the shoes of his kids thinking what life is like for them.     {
      "key": "bf59055214cfd5bdda33e705ff4718120091308d",
      "title": "Colin Murray - A Countdown Conundrum",
      "published_at": "2024-10-01T23:10:00+00:00",
      "link": null,
      "description": "Countdown has been a staple of British TV on Channel 4 for over four decades and is now hosted by Colin Murray. How did a boy who was kicked out of school, become the chair of a show all about numbers and letters? Colin has had a rich career across TV and radio, including Radio 1 where Harry was a dedicated listener and we’ll hear how Harry played a part in Colin’s final Radio 1 show. Alongside comedian and broadcaster Elis James, Colin hosts the excellent podcast Everything To Play For which you can listen to wherever you get your podcasts. Harry and Colin love a curry so we spoke to curry expert Lizzy Collingham who gave us some very surprising facts! Lizzie’s book Curry: A Tale of Cooks and Conquerors can be found here .       "key": "032ceb61c3cd85568ea4a7d5738c5b90eece1de5",
      "title": "Russell Kane - Just Got To Go For It",
      "published_at": "2024-08-05T23:10:00+00:00",
      "link": null,
      "description": "A young man from Essex who didn’t really know what stand-up comedy was until his twenties, Russell Kane has gone on to become one of the UK’s best comedians since taking the chance to step on stage. How did Russell catch the comedy bug? Can he identify a musty flannel? Who will he put in the virtual graveyard? In this episode we learn all about leeches.
